_doc: Guns written for Queen (GDD 10.3). A gun costs 0 to equip unless its power earns a cost. Its `effects` are Equip ops, run once when it is equipped; `weapon.special` changes its rolls; `hooks` react while it is equipped.

SNUB_NOSE.name: Snub Nose
SNUB_NOSE.text: Equip: Fire. +0 dice. 3 damage per hit.

plus.text: Equip: Fire. +0 dice. 4 damage per hit.

SCOUT_CARBINE.name: Scout Carbine
SCOUT_CARBINE.text: Equip: draw 2. +1 die. 2 damage per hit.

plus.text: Equip: draw 2. +1 die. 3 damage per hit.

HIVE_SPLITTER.name: Hive Splitter
HIVE_SPLITTER.text: Equip: Fire. +3 dice. Rolls of 4 count as hits. Crit. 3 damage per hit.
